ghi_chu_chung: Thu vien nen trung tinh dung cho part template KHONG co input anh (section-title, section-header, stat-counter, typewriter-reveal, date-stamp, dual-stat, checklist, source-citation...). Loai tru: cutaway-standard (DEC-268) va preview-banner (DEC-274) du khong co input anh — hai template nay bat buoc anh/video that. Moi scene toi da 1 part dung nen (DEC-244). Anh nam trong thu muc image/, video nam trong thu muc video/. Anh ti le 2:3 can crop giua ve 9:16 (720x1280) truoc khi dung; anh dung 9:16 va video da dung 9:16. MO TA CHI TIET (09/11/2026): moi muc co mo_ta chi tiet (noi dung, mau sac, bo cuc, anh sang, vung sang/toi de dat chu) + phu_hop chi tiet (chu de, loai template, mood, vi tri dat chu) + tu_khoa (tu khoa tieng Viet + tieng Anh) — de AI chon anh nhanh va chinh xac theo chu de/kich ban. CEO dang loc thu vien: da xoa 3 anh dot 3 (sport-01, trans-01, space-01), 7 anh (08, 10, 15, 17, edu-01-blackboard, energy-02-turbines-dusk, env-01-forest-fog), 5 video (25, 26, health-02, news-02, space-02) va 2 video (21-bokeh, energy-02-solar-rooftop) — da xoa khoi JSON nay. File nao CEO bo thi xoa khoi thu muc va khoi JSON nay.
